title: Fix the Missing Return Value
description: The program should define a function that squares a number and print the result. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 25, the square of 5.
actualProblem: The function computes result but never returns it, so the function implicitly returns None, and the program prints None instead of 25.
correctedCode:
def square(n):
    result = n * n
    return result

print(square(5))
explanation: A function only sends a value back to its caller via an explicit return statement. Without one, Python functions return None by default, no matter what was computed inside.
